claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The magic-item activation shell, charge pool, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction all fit, but the current spell-access surface can only cast the referenced spell using its normal resolution context. Wand of Web needs the cast to carry a fixed DC 13 instead of the wielder's spell save DC.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Web (save DC 13) from it.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_wand_of_web.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
